::: {.bio}
I am a senior undergraduate at Bilkent University working on **computer vision**, **generative modeling**, and **medical image reconstruction**. I study how generative models can solve inverse problems in computational imaging; currently, fast physics-aware generative methods for accelerated multicoil MRI, supervised by Prof. Tolga Çukur.
:::
